direct_run_trace.note: SUMO refused to reinsert the vehicle on the closed edge and placed it on the edge AFTER the closure, so this teleport produced no entry at all

unplanned_finding.note: schedules disqualified with no teleport and no throughput at all. Fixing teleports alone cannot make these eligible; they are vehicles with no route, a failure mode the plan's stages 2-3 do not address

verdict.holds: teleports are a NECESSARY condition: throughput never occurs without them in any of the 75 schedules
verdict.premise: CLOSURE_INTEGRITY_PLAN 1.1 claimed the leak and the teleports are one event counted twice
verdict.refuted: they are not the same event. Teleports occur without any throughput, and a directly observed teleport was REFUSED entry to the closed edge and landed past it
